Ā^tramītae , ārum, m., = Ἀδραμῖται,
I.a people in the eastern part of Arabia Felix, now Hadramaut, Plin. 6, 28, 32, § 154; 12, 14, 30, § 52; cf. Mann. Arab. 79.— Hence, Ā^tramītĭcus , a, um, adj., of or from the country of the Atramitœ, Atramitic: “myrrha,” Plin. 12, 16, 35, § 69 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
